title: Smallest number of variables for undecidable Hilbert's Tenth Problem over Z
exact_target: What is the smallest fixed number of variables for which deciding existence of an integer root of an arbitrary integer polynomial becomes algorithmically impossible?

sources.citation: William Gasarch, Hilbert's Tenth Problem: Refinements and Variants (2021), Notation 3.1 and Theorems 4.1-4.2.
